1.name: Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
1.purpose: Provides direct financial support to women in Maharashtra to foster economic independence, address basic health and nutritional needs, and elevate their role in family decision-making.
1.benefits: ₹1,500 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Total annual benefit of ₹18,000 per family.
1.eligibility: Resident female of Maharashtra; age 21 to 65 years; applicable to married, widowed, divorced, abandoned, or destitute women, and one unmarried woman per family; family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000. Exclusions include taxpayers, permanent government employees, or families owning a 4-wheeler (excluding tractors).
1.documents_required: Aadhaar Card; Domicile Certificate (or 15-year Ration Card / Voter ID / Birth Certificate); Income Certificate (or Yellow/Orange Ration Card); Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook; Self-Declaration Form (Hamipatra) and Passport Photograph.
1.application_procedure: Register on the official Ladki Bahin portal or Nari Shakti Doot App; fill in personal details, address, and bank credentials; upload scanned documents and complete Aadhaar-based OTP verification.

2.name: Lek Ladki Yojana
2.purpose: Promotes the birth, health, and higher education of girl children while working to curb female foeticide and early child marriage across Maharashtra.
2.benefits: Total financial grant of ₹1,01,000 in 5 milestones: ₹5,000 at birth; ₹6,000 on admission to Class 1; ₹7,000 on admission to Class 6; ₹8,000 on admission to Class 11; ₹75,000 on turning 18.
2.eligibility: Girl child born on or after April 1, 2023 in Maharashtra; family must possess a Yellow or Orange Ration Card.
2.documents_required: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child; Parents' Aadhaar Cards; Yellow / Orange Ration Card; Family Income Certificate; Bank Account Passbook of Mother/Child.
2.application_procedure: Submit physical application form through local Anganwadi workers or the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) at the Gram Panchayat/Urban Ward level.

3.name: Punyashlok Ahilya Devi Holkar Mahila Startup Yojana
3.purpose: Provides early-stage financial seed capital, incubation, and business development support to female entrepreneurs leading innovative startups.
3.benefits: Financial assistance, seed funding grants, and low-interest enterprise loans; mentorship access; free incubation access; priority in state government procurement.
3.eligibility: Woman-founded or co-founded startup registered in Maharashtra; must be recognized by DPIIT (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade).
3.documents_required: Business Registration Certificate & Pitch Deck; DPIIT Recognition Certificate; Founder's Aadhaar & PAN Card; Bank Account Details & Financial Statements.
3.application_procedure: Apply online through the Maharashtra State Innovation Society (MSInS) portal and submit startup credentials for committee review.

4.name: Mahila Samridhi Yojana (LIDCOM)
4.purpose: Offers low-interest micro-finance loans to marginalized women from targeted backward/Charmakar communities to set up micro-enterprises.
4.benefits: Micro-loans ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹50,000; highly subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum.
4.eligibility: Resident female of Maharashtra belonging to designated backward classes; family annual income under ₹98,000 (Rural) or ₹1,20,000 (Urban).
4.documents_required: Aadhaar Card & Voter ID; Caste Certificate & Income Certificate; Domicile Certificate; Bank Details & Micro-business plan proposal.
4.application_procedure: Obtain application form from the District Office of LIDCOM, fill details, attach documents, and submit offline.

5.name: Asmita Yojana
5.purpose: Provides heavily subsidized sanitary napkins to rural schoolgirls and women through Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to promote menstrual hygiene.
5.benefits: High-quality sanitary napkin packs provided at ₹5 per pack for rural school girls; heavily discounted rates for rural adult women.
5.eligibility: Female students in rural Zilla Parishad schools aged 11–19 and rural women in Maharashtra.
5.documents_required: School ID Card (for students) / Asmita Card; Aadhaar Card.
5.application_procedure: Eligible school girls receive Asmita Cards via Zilla Parishad schools to purchase subsidized packs from local Anganwadi workers or registered SHGs.

6.name: Mahila Samman Yojana (MSRTC Travel Concession)
6.purpose: Provides affordable public transport for all female citizens across urban and rural Maharashtra.
6.benefits: 50% discount on ticket fares across all bus categories operated by Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC).
6.eligibility: All female passengers traveling within Maharashtra state borders.
6.documents_required: Valid Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving License) upon request.
6.application_procedure: Direct discount applied at ticket counters or online MSRTC booking portals upon selecting the female passenger option.

7.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
7.purpose: A conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme providing financial support to pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage loss recovery and nutrition.
7.benefits: ₹5,000 for the first child, disbursed in 2 installments; ₹6,000 in a single installment for the second child, provided the second child is a girl.
7.eligibility: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) aged 19 years or older; excludes regular employees of Central/State Governments or PSUs.
7.documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Applicant and Husband; Mother-Child Protection (MCP) Card; Aadhaar-linked Bank/Post Office Account Passbook; Child Birth Certificate.
7.application_procedure: Apply online via the PMMVY Portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) or submit Form 1-A offline at nearest Anganwadi Centre / Health Facility.

8.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
8.purpose: Provides deposit-free LPG gas connections to women from economically weaker households to protect them from hazardous indoor smoke.
8.benefits: Free deposit-free LPG connection valued at ₹1,600; free first cylinder refill and gas stove; direct targeted financial subsidy on subsequent refill cylinders.
8.eligibility: Female applicant aged 18 years or above; must belong to BPL / SC / ST / Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin) household without an existing LPG connection.
8.documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Applicant and all adult family members; Ration Card / BPL Proof; Bank Account Details (Aadhaar Linked); Address Proof.
8.application_procedure: Submit application online via PMUY portal or visit local LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas) with supporting documents.

9.name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
9.purpose: Empowers women in Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to start sustainable micro-businesses and achieve a target annual household income of at least ₹1,00,000.
9.benefits: Skill training in high-demand trades such as drone operation, LED assembly, tailoring, organic farming, and food processing; access to collateral-free, interest-subsidized micro-credit through SHG networks.
9.eligibility: Active female member of a Self-Help Group (SHG) under National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) in Maharashtra.
9.documents_required: Aadhaar Card & SHG Membership details; Bank Account details; Income Certificate / BPL details.
9.application_procedure: Contact local Self-Help Group leader or Gram Panchayat NRLM coordinator to enroll in skill training and loan sanctioning.

10.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
10.purpose: A small-deposit savings scheme designed exclusively for girl children to build a dedicated fund for higher education and marriage.
10.benefits: Government-backed interest rate stated in the source as approximately 8.2% p.a.; full tax exemption under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act; partial withdrawal allowed for higher education after the girl reaches age 18.
10.eligibility: Account opened by parent/legal guardian for a girl child under 10 years of age; maximum 2 accounts per family (3 in case of twin girls birth).
10.documents_required: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child; Aadhaar Card & PAN Card of Parent/Guardian; Proof of Residence & Passport Photo.
10.application_procedure: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank branch, fill the SSY opening form, and deposit initial amount (minimum ₹250).

11.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
11.purpose: Facilitates bank loans for women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield (new) ventures in manufacturing, services, trading, or agriculture-allied activities.
11.benefits: Bank loan amounts ranging from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore; composite loan covering working capital and term loan requirements.
11.eligibility: Female entrepreneur aged 18 years or above; enterprise must be a greenfield project; non-individual enterprise must have 51% female shareholding/control.
11.documents_required: Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID; Project Report & Business Plan; Proof of Business Address & Asset Documents; last 3 years Income Tax Returns if applicable.
11.application_procedure: Apply online on the Stand-Up Mitra portal (standupmitra.in) or visit any commercial bank branch.

12.name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
12.purpose: A small savings initiative for women and girls offering guaranteed fixed returns over a short-term tenure.
12.benefits: Fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum, compounded quarterly; flexible deposit amount from ₹1,000 up to ₹2,00,000 for a 2-year tenure.
12.eligibility: Any woman individual in her own name or a guardian on behalf of a minor girl.
12.documents_required: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card; Account Opening Form & Passport Photographs.
12.application_procedure: Submit account opening form at nearest Post Office or participating public sector banks.

13.name: Mudra Yojana for Women (PMMY)
13.purpose: Provides collateral-free loans to women running micro-enterprises, beauty parlors, tailoring units, small shops, or home businesses.
13.benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakhs across 3 categories: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishor ₹50,000–₹5 Lakhs; Tarun ₹5 Lakhs–₹10 Lakhs. Lower interest concessions may be offered by specific banks for female borrowers.
13.eligibility: Female proprietor/partner running small business enterprises in the non-farm sector.
13.documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN; Business Address Proof & Registration/Licence; Bank Statements for the last 6 months.
13.application_procedure: Apply through any commercial bank, RRB, NBFC, or online via UdyamiMitra portal.

14.name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
14.purpose: Provides safe, affordable, and conveniently located hostel accommodation with daycare facilities for working women in urban centers.
14.benefits: Safe housing at subsidized monthly rates; daycare/creche facility for children of working mothers.
14.eligibility: Working women (single, widowed, divorced, separated, married) whose spouse/family does not reside in the same city; gross monthly income limit applies and varies by metropolitan vs non-metro city.
14.documents_required: Aadhaar Card & Employment Proof / Salary Slip; Declaration of Income & Application Form.
14.application_procedure: Apply directly to the managing NGO / State Women Development Corporation managing Sakhi Niwas in cities such as Mumbai, Pune, and Nagpur.

15.name: One Stop Centre Scheme (Sakhi)
15.purpose: Provides integrated support and assistance under one roof to women affected by violence, distress, or harassment.
15.benefits: 24x7 emergency response, temporary shelter, medical assistance, legal aid/counseling, and psychological support.
15.eligibility: Any woman or girl child facing violence, harassment, or severe distress.
15.documents_required: No mandatory documents required for immediate emergency assistance.
15.application_procedure: Contact National Women Helpline (181) or visit nearest District Hospital One Stop Centre directly.
